post.description: Generate a Doppler Share link by sending an encrypted secret. The receive flow the user goes through will be end-to-end encrypted where the encrypted secret will be decrypted on the browser.

encrypted_secret.description: Ecrypted secret using AES-GCM with a symmetric key derived from a cryptographically random 64 character passphrase using PBKDF2. 1,000,000 salt rounds required. Then base64 encode the encrypted secret.

hashed_password.description: SHA256 hash of the password. This is NOT the hash of the derived encryption key.

expire_views.description: Number of views before the link expires. Valid ranges: 1 to 50. -1 for unlimited.

expire_days.description: Number of days before the link expires. Valid range: 1 to 90.

encryption_kdf.description: The key derivation function used. Must by "pbkdf2".

encryption_salt_rounds.description: Number of salt rounds used by KDF. Must be "1000000".

post.description: Generate a Doppler Share link by sending a plain text secret. This endpoint is not end-to-end encrypted as you are sending the secret in plain text. At no point do we store the plain text secret or the password in our systems. The receive flow the user goes through will be end-to-end encrypted where the encrypted secret will be decrypted on the browser.

expire_views.description: Number of views before the link expires. Valid ranges: 1 to 50. -1 for unlimited.

expire_days.description: Number of days before the link expires. Valid range: 1 to 90.

post.description: Secrets

project.description: Unique identifier for the project object.

secrets.description: Either `secrets` or `change_requests` is required (can't use both). Object of secrets you would like to save to the config. Try it with the sample secrets below.

change_requests.description: Either `secrets` or `change_requests` is required (can't use both). Object of secrets you would like to save to the config. Try it with the sample secrets below.

originalName.description: The original name of the secret. Use `null` (an actual `null`, not the string `null`) or omit this parameter for new secrets. If it differs from `name` then a rename is inferred.

value.description: The value the secret should have. Use `null` (an actual `null`, not the string `null`) to leave the existing secret value unchanged.

originalValue.description: The value you expect the secret to have before `name` is applied. If specified, the request will only be processed if the provided value matches what's found in Doppler.

visibility.description: Must be set to either `masked`, `unmasked`, or `restricted`.

originalVisibility.description: Must be set to either `masked`, `unmasked`, or `restricted`. The visibility you expect the secret to have before `visibility` is applied. If specified, the request will only be processed if the provided visibility matches what's found in Doppler.

shouldPromote.description: Defaults to `false`. Can only be set to `true` if the config being updated is a branch config. If set to `true`, the provided secret will be set in both the branch config as well as the root config in that environment.

shouldDelete.description: Defaults to `false`. If set to `true`, will delete the secret matching the `name` field.

shouldConverge.description: Defaults to `false`. Can only be set to `true` if the config being updated is a branch config and there is a secret with the same name in the root config. In this case, the branch secret will inherit the value and visibility type from the root secret.

valueType.description: The default valueType (string) will result in no validations being applied.

originalValueType.description: The valueType you expect the secret to have before `valueType` is applied. If specified, the request will only be processed if the provided valueType matches what's found in Doppler.
